summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Furniture Production P05 - Making a Blanket ## Creating the Plate To start, create a plate with dimensions of **500mm x 800mm**. ## Positioning the Plate Use the positioning ball to accurately position the plate near the backrest of the furniture. ## Creating the Inner Line for Folding Select the outer line of the plate and then utilize the **inner line support function** to create the inner line that will be used for folding. ## Folding the Plate Next, choose the **fold arrangement tool** to fold both sides of the board. ## Simulating the Blanket After folding, continue by opening the simulation to let the blanket hang from the back of the furniture. ### Troubleshooting the Simulation If you encounter issues where the blanket appears frozen, with the sheet and model penetrating each other, you can activate the simulation again. ## Deleting the Inner Line Once the simulation is activated, delete the inner line that was used for folding. ## Adjusting Particle Strength To enhance the simulation, reduce the particle strength of the sheet and simulate again for better results. ## Changing Fabric Type Replace the current fabric with **Knit**. Turn on the Knit feature. ## Congratulations! Congratulations! You have successfully applied the Knit fabric to the blanket. ```
